_doc: Public-domain instructional books for the TOTE harvester. Rights verified 2026-11-01 from each Project Gutenberg HTML file's <meta name=dc.rights> ('Public domain in the USA.') and gutendex copyright=false. ISBN: none of these files contains an ISBN, and all predate ISBN (1970); isbn=null is a finding, not a gap to fill. Reprints carry their own ISBNs but different editions/pagination, so they are NOT used.

politeness.note: Each book is fetched once and cached under shared/data/corpus/ (gitignored). Gutenberg asks bulk users to use mirrors; for >5 books use a mirror/rsync instead.

derived_page_method: page = floor(char_offset_in_extracted_body_text / 2000) + 1, flagged page_kind=derived. 2000 chars approximates one printed page of 1900s prose; it does NOT correspond to any printed edition.
